title: EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities
abstract: arXiv:2611.14356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host--device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer change

translated_title: EngineAgent：具备推理栈层级感知与硬件能力的端侧LLM推理引擎智能体化
translated_abstract: 快速演进的LLM架构与异构的移动硬件，使得在端侧推理引擎中支持新模型成为一项反复出现且成本高昂的系统挑战。每个模型可能需要在转换、图构建、算子以及硬件后端等多个层面进行协同修改。现有的编程智能体往往忽略这些跨层依赖关系，并且难以诊断主机—设备执行路径上的故障。我们提出了EngineAgent，一个用于自动化端侧LLM模型适配的智能体系统。其核心洞察是将可复用的引擎与硬件知识从模型特定的实现中分离出来。在模型适配之前，EngineAgent会构建一个层级感知的引擎索引，以捕捉引擎抽象层与跨层依赖关系，并利用已支持的模型预先验证后端特定的构建、执行和调试工作流程。对于每个新模型，构建器（builder）利用这些知识来协调跨层变更。
tldr: EngineAgent通过构建层级感知的引擎索引并利用已支持模型预先验证后端工作流程，将可复用的引擎与硬件知识从模型特定实现中分离，从而自动化端侧LLM推理引擎的新模型适配过程。
en_tdlr: EngineAgent automates on-device LLM model enablement by constructing a hierarchy-aware engine index and pre-validating backend workflows with already supported models, separating reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation.
